# The Terminal Corporation

The Terminal Corporation is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Logistics Management for Warehousing & Transportation is a company that provides logistics services for warehousing and transportation services since 1893. They have restructured their terminal corporation to enhance their focus on key market segments. The company aims to serve their customers' evolving needs while maintaining a family-oriented culture. The Terminal Corporation employs 47 people (+11.9% YoY, +5 people) and has an annual revenue of $26.7M, founded in 1893. Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, United States, with an office in Dundalk.

## About

The Terminal Corporation has moved and stored freight since 1893. Four generations, one family, and we intend to keep it that way. We operate our own network of port-adjacent warehouses and are an asset-based transportation provider up and down the East Coast, handling most non-hazardous cargoes. Our services include public & contract warehousing, short-term storage & laydown, container stripping & restuffing, cross-docking, transloading, breakbulk, heavy lift, RO-RO, container drayage and regional FTL delivery services. With our own assets, we're positioned to handle cargo from port to destination - eliminating your need to manage multiple vendors and multiple points of failure. Being family-owned means fast decisions with no outside investors and no layers of approval slowing things down. When a shipment gets complicated, our team finds a way to make it work - that's been true for over 130 years, and it's still how we operate today.
